_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Contract Government Furnished Material (GFM) Monthly Requisition and Inventory Report
summary: The Contract GFM Monthly Requisition and Inventory Report provides the Government with monthly information for determining GFM balances by condition code, consumption, turn-ins, transfers, due-ins, receipts, and shipping actions.
use_relationship:
The Contract Government Furnished Material (GFM) Monthly Requisition and Inventory Report provides the Government with monthly information for determining GFM balances by condition code, consumption, turn-ins, transfers, due-ins, receipts, and shipping actions.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.
b. This DID may be used on any depot level maintenance contract.
c. This DID supersedes DI-MGMT-82128.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Contract GFM Monthly Requisition and Inventory Report shall be in the Table I format below.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Contract GFM Monthly Requisition and Inventory Report shall include the following data, provided by the Production Management Specialist (PMS) and the Contractor, through the end of the month:

children.title: Blocks 1 through 3 of the report shall contain the following information provided by the PMS:
As-Of Date:
children.content: The day, month, and year (DDMMMYYYY) applicable to the report. Data shall be through the end of the month.

children.title: Block 1:
children.content: PMS's name, PMS's code, PMS's email address, and PMS's phone number.

children.title: Block 2:
children.content: The name of the business and the Department of Defense Activity Address Code (DoDAAC) assigned to the business for shipment of material. The contractor's Commercial and Government Entity (CAGE) Code, email address, and phone number shall also be included.

children.title: Block 3:
children.content: Government Item Manager's or Technical Point of Contact (POC)'s name.

children.title: Blocks A through O of the Contract GFM Monthly Requisition and Inventory Report shall include the following:
Block B: Contract # GFM is authorized under
Block G: Transfer in from another order or adjusted (ADJ)
Block H: Transfer out or ADJ
Block I: Sum QTY Issued to Repair Line
